title: Lee Kang-in Joins Atlético Madrid From PSG on Five-Year Deal
dek: South Korean midfielder Lee Kang-in, 25, has joined Atlético Madrid from Paris Saint-Germain on a five-year contract running through June 30, 2031. Lee made 124 appearances for PSG, scoring 16 goals and providing 16 assists, and won 12 trophies including two Champions League titles and three Ligue 1 crowns over three seasons.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Lee signed a five-year contract with Atlético Madrid and brings Champions League and Ligue 1 experience from PSG.
bottom_line: Lee brings established European pedigree and trophy experience to Atlético Madrid in a competitive La Liga environment. Watch whether his Champions League background translates into immediate impact in La Liga, and how he integrates into Atlético's midfield structure.
body: South Korean midfielder Lee Kang-in, 25, has transferred from Paris Saint-Germain to Atlético Madrid on a five-year contract running through June 30, 2031, according to ESPN.

Lee began his career with Valencia, making his first-team debut in October 2018 in the Copa del Rey. He made 62 appearances for Valencia before joining Mallorca in August 2021. After two seasons at Mallorca, he signed for PSG in the summer of 2023.

At PSG, Lee featured 124 times, scoring 16 goals and providing 16 assists over three seasons, per ESPN. He won 12 trophies during his tenure in Paris, including two Champions League titles and three Ligue 1 crowns, according to ESPN reporting.

International performance: Lee made his first senior appearance for South Korea in September 2019 and has since earned 50 caps while scoring 10 goals for his country, per ESPN. He recently featured at this year's World Cup, playing in all three of South Korea's Group A fixtures, according to ESPN.
The brief provided does not contain the transfer fee, wage details, Lee's stated reasons for the move, or Atlético Madrid's strategic rationale for the signing.
